checkpoint.title: Cerulean: Potions, a GRIND to Lv23, then into the Gym, saved below Misty's platform
notes: Cerulean Gym (pokefirered CeruleanCity_Gym map.json and scripts.inc): a pool with walkways. Misty (8, 6) stands on a platform (7..9, 6) above row 7. Picnicker Diana (4, 7) faces east, sight 4, over (5..8, 7), so misty_front (8, 7) is in her line; Swimmer Luis (10, 12) in the water faces west, sight 1, over (9, 12), on column 9 north of the door. No gym trainer has to be fought for Misty, so neither is: from the door up column 9 to row 13 (a route there, so the planner's walk to a wall doesn't run on past it through (9, 12)), west to (4, 13), and to walls round the pool's west and north sides, (4, 10), (12, 10), (12, 7), then west to (9, 7), the tile below the platform's east end, out of Diana's line. 00.14c steps up onto (9, 6) and talks to Misty from beside her.

Misty beat a Lv20 Wartortle (console B, run m51), so first a GRIND to Lv23 on 00.15's patch. Gen 3 numbers (pokefirered: her mons have IV 0; Wartortle taken at IV 15, no EVs): Starmie Lv21 has 56 HP, Atk 36, SpA 47, SpD 40. Bite is Dark, special in Gen 3, no STAB, x2 on Psychic: at Lv23 (SpA 39) it does 23..28, three hits (two on top rolls); at Lv20, 20..24. Her Swift (physical, 60) does 9..11 to a Lv23 Wartortle (about 67 HP, Def 45) and Water Pulse (STAB, resisted) 8..10: 6 or more hits, though m51 saw about 20 a turn. Her Recover (28) and Super Potion undo a Bite, so the margin is in Bite's damage.

The Mart comes before the GRIND: its wild battles are fought only with 2 or more Potions, and 00.14's save has none (m51 met Misty with only the 5 this row bought). 5 Potions (row 3, 300 each), then up to 3 Super Potions (row 2, 700), last so they take the Items pocket's last row; the battle doesn't use them yet. The money box can't be read, so the floor stands for it, and a floor above the money fails the step (the quantity box wraps). Prizes (pokefirered: 4 x last level x the class's factor) from a new game's 3000, less Viridian's 2000 and the Magikarp's 500: Liam 220, Brock 1400, Route 3's bug catchers 360, the Mt. Moon grunt 416 and Miguel 288 (the first rival's 80 only if won), at least 3184 here. Floor and budget 3000: 5 Potions and 2 Super Potions, 2900. Misty's 2100 (4 x 21 x 25) then leaves 00.15 its floor of 1500. Then the nurse, and the save before Misty, so her battle is its own checkpoint, 00.14c, verified and retried from it. 00.15's GRIND then fights until the sim beats the Cerulean rival often enough.
